protocol.name: Dr.Bokeh full-pipeline implementation preflight, then single-adapter Track A
protocol.predicted_alpha: Official LDF model-40, from RGB only; official resize/normalization and sigmoid
protocol.layer_pipeline: Official RGBAD2layers; two layers; foreground cv2 depth inpaint, background LaMa RGB AND depth inpaint; Multi_Layer_Renderer
protocol.normalization: lo=min(d); span=max(d)-lo; d_prime=(d-lo)/span; focus_prime=(focus-lo)/span; no focus clamp
protocol.K_mapping: K_Dr = K_manifest * span; preserves K_Dr*(d_prime-focus_prime)=K_manifest*(d-focus) BEFORE layer preprocessing
protocol.constant_disparity_policy: Stop and report; no silent fallback or per-scene parameter change
protocol.precision: FP32 render/model, TF32 disabled; preserve official NumPy/OpenCV preprocessing dtypes
protocol.output: Independent frames; clamp only final RGB to [0,1], record out-of-range fraction before clamp, round to RGB PNG8

kernel_check.scope: Engineering tolerance declared before probe; not a paper score threshold or proof for arbitrary occlusion normalization

preflight_checks: Same 8 scenes, 25 frames each, 1024x576; filename focus matches metadata
Before layers, signed CoC algebra matches existing input control after K compensation
Record LDF coverage and empty/full masks; poor segmentation is a retained method failure unless the pipeline becomes undefined.
Foreground/background RGBAD finite; inspect LaMa RGB and depth fills separately
Record actual layer disparity range and maximum nominal radius after preprocessing
Check radial tail coverage for actual post-preprocessing radius; if failed, stop without clipping
Check final output shape/range and focus-region visual behavior
Inspect 0/6/12/18/24 frame diagnostics; compare 71 versus 101 on identical saved layers from the fixed K32 scenes, because near-zero normalization weights can amplify small kernel tails
limits: No public evidence located that Any-to-Bokeh gives Dr.Bokeh GT alpha or oracle layers; absence of disclosure is not proof of their actual private settings.

Dr.Bokeh CVPR 2024 section 5.2 replaces predicted occluded pixels by GT pixels for MPIB/Dr.Bokeh and searches blur kernels. This is a different experiment and does not establish Any-to-Bokeh's unpublished adapter.
Official demo does not transform its focal argument for the caller; adapter must transform it consistently.
CUDA scatter_dis=abs(relative_disparity)*K_Dr+1 with a softstep edge, not an ideal hard disk of exactly the nominal radius.
lens is a kernel side length; circular mask uses distance < floor(lens/2); soft tails never have exactly finite support.
K compensation preserves nominal input CoC, not full-pipeline equivalence: depth inpainting and fixed disparity-domain occlusion thresholds are not affine invariant.
A single oracle-alpha image would still not reveal all hidden RGBA layers and is not a pure-renderer ground truth test.
The native soft kernel has nonzero residual spread at nominal radius zero; do not demand exact identity as an implementation pass condition.
User authorized the full 200 scenes only after the fixed 8-scene implementation checks pass; no paper-score selection or additional candidates.

layered_lens_check.edge_definition: 5x5 morphological gradient of LDF alpha>0.1, OR input normalized disparity local range>1/255
layered_lens_check.selection: If 71/101 differences exceed tolerance on the same saved layers, use 101 as coverage correction; no paper metrics consulted.

next_action: Run the frozen single adapter on 200 scenes; preflight accepted and already reused.
